summary.en: Western Sichuan rises quickly from basin to 3000m+ passes; altitude sickness risk.
summary.zh: 川西从盆地快速爬升至 3000m+ 垭口，高原反应风险高。

mitigations.en: Do not rush Chengdu→highlands in one day; sleep intermediate towns.
mitigations.zh: 勿成都直冲高原一日达；安排过渡夜宿。
套用 CN_SICHUAN 风险阈值（高海拔 3000m）。

summary.en: Mountain roads, landslides in rainy season, winter ice on passes.
summary.zh: 山区道路、雨季滑坡、冬季垭口结冰。

mitigations.en: Check pass status; avoid night mountain driving.
mitigations.zh: 出发前查垭口路况；避免夜间山路。

summary.en: Basin summer heat/humidity vs highland cold; large diurnal swing.
summary.zh: 盆地湿热 vs 高原寒冷，昼夜温差大。

mitigations.en: Pack layered clothing for basin-to-highland transitions.
mitigations.zh: 盆地进高原需分层穿衣。

items.zh: 进入 3500m+ 前安排适应夜

items.en: Altitude meds / portable oxygen if needed
Fuel plan for sparse western segments
items.zh: 川西稀疏路段加油计划

items.en: Jiuzhaigou / other timed tickets if applicable
items.zh: 九寨沟等热门票预约（如适用）

message.en: Western Sichuan: avoid rapid ascent from Chengdu basin to high passes in a single day.
message.zh: 川西：避免从成都盆地单日急升至高海拔垭口。

title.en: Insert intermediate lodging for altitude gain
title.zh: 为大高差插入过渡住宿

message.en: Rainy season: watch for landslides and temporary road closures on western corridors.
message.zh: 雨季关注川西廊道塌方与临时封路。

message.en: Winter passes may require chains / close; do not plan night crossings.
message.zh: 冬季垭口可能需防滑链或封闭；禁止规划夜间过垭口。

message.en: Stock fuel/food in Chengdu or Kangding before sparse western segments.
message.zh: 进入川西稀疏段前在成都或康定补充燃油与物资。
